targetTexts.1: For behold, the Lord GOD of Hosts is about to remove from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: the whole supply of food and water,
targetTexts.2: the mighty man and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the soothsayer and the elder,
targetTexts.3: the commander of fifty and the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician, and the clever enchanter.
targetTexts.4: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
targetTexts.5: The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the young will rise up against the old, and the base against the honorable.
targetTexts.6: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
targetTexts.7: On that day he will cry aloud: “I am not a healer. I have no food or clothing in my house. Do not make me leader of the people!”
targetTexts.8: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they spoke and acted against the LORD, defying His glorious presence.
targetTexts.9: The expression on their faces testifies against them, and like Sodom they flaunt their sin; they do not conceal it. Woe to them, for they have brought disaster upon themselves.
targetTexts.10: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
targetTexts.11: Woe to the wicked; disaster is upon them! For they will be repaid with what their hands have done.
targetTexts.12: Youths oppress My people, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides mislead you; they turn you from your paths.
targetTexts.13: The LORD arises to contend; He stands to judge the people.
targetTexts.14: The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people: “You have devoured the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
targetTexts.15: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
targetTexts.16: The LORD also says: “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty—walking with heads held high and wanton eyes, prancing and skipping as they go, jingling the bracelets on their ankles—
targetTexts.17: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their foreheads bare.”
targetTexts.18: In that day the Lord will take away their finery: their anklets and headbands and crescents;
targetTexts.20: their headdresses, ankle chains, and sashes; their perfume bottles and charms;
targetTexts.21: their signet rings and nose rings;
targetTexts.22: their festive robes, capes, cloaks, and purses;
targetTexts.23: and their mirrors, linen garments, tiaras, and shawls.
targetTexts.24: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of styled hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, shame.
targetTexts.25: Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors in battle.
targetTexts.26: And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
